channel.title: Uniq — News
channel.description: Foundation news and the stories of people going through recovery.

item.title: The start of cooperation with SGPP
item.description: The Swiss Society for Psychiatry and Psychotherapy funds 165 free consultations for Ukrainians.

item.title: The mental health of deminers: results of the work with MAG
item.description: A partnership with the Ukrainian branch of the Mines Advisory Group since February 2024. In May the MAG team in Mykolaiv survived an airstrike.

item.title: From 4 to 87: portraits of the youngest and the oldest beneficiaries
item.description: The platform's youngest client is four years old and the oldest is eighty-seven. Between them lies the whole war.

item.title: More than 2,000 Ukrainians will receive free psychological help
item.description: The result of the collaboration with German Doctors — by the end of the year.

item.title: Psychological support for older people — with thanks to Medair
item.description: A group that usually comes last in the queue for attention: older people who have lived through the war.

item.title: EQ.app gains ground on Google Play
item.description: One hundred thousand downloads on the store, a 4.4 rating and more than 1,200 reviews.

item.title: The EQ.app team at Web Summit
item.description: Taking part in Europe's largest technology conference as a national ambassador for Ukraine.

item.title: EQ.app in the VentureWell business incubator
item.description: A six-month GIST incubation programme in the United States.

item.title: More than 1,000 consultations since the project began
item.description: The platform's first milestone, broken down: who delivered the help, who received it, and what share were displaced.

item.title: The Heroes project resumes its work
item.description: The complex rehabilitation programme for demobilised soldiers returns, on a methodology developed back in 2016.
